details.description: FLUX.1 [dev] is a 12 billion parameter rectified flow transformer from Black Forest Labs that generates images from text descriptions. It is the open-weight, guidance-distilled version of Black Forest Labs' flagship line, offering what the model card calls output quality "second only to" the closed FLUX.1 [pro] model. Fireworks AI hosts it (accounts/fireworks/models/flux-1-dev) for on-demand, dedicated-GPU deployment. As of September 2026, Black Forest Labs' models showcase page (bfl.ai/models) is centered on the newer FLUX.2 and FLUX 3 families and no longer lists FLUX.1 [dev], though Black Forest Labs' own API docs still document a live, undeprecated endpoint for generating images with FLUX.1 [dev], and the Hugging Face model card remains published with no deprecation notice.
advantages: Black Forest Labs describes it as offering "competitive prompt following, matching the performance of closed source alternatives".
Trained with guidance distillation, which the model card states makes FLUX.1 [dev] more efficient than a non-distilled equivalent.
Open-weight model whose inference code and weights are published, so it can be self-hosted via Diffusers, ComfyUI, or Fireworks' on-demand deployment.
disadvantages: Licensed under the FLUX.1 [dev] Non-Commercial License, which restricts commercial use without a separate agreement.
Fireworks lists fine-tuning, serverless deployment, image input, and embeddings as not supported for this model.
Does not appear on Black Forest Labs' current models listing, which as of September 2026 is centered on the newer FLUX.2 and FLUX 3 generations.
use_cases: Generating images from text prompts for non-commercial or locally licensed use
Prompts that include rendered text, per the model card's example prompts

notes: GROUPING/kind conflict: the catalog lists this entry as kind "chat" with endpoint /v1/chat/completions and modality [text_input, text_output], max_input/output_tokens 4096. The maker (Hugging Face card) and host (Fireworks model page) both confirm this is a text-to-image diffusion model, not a chat/text model, and Fireworks' own image-generation variants of FLUX (e.g. flux-1-dev-fp8) use /v1/images/generations with image_output modality instead. I kept the catalog's facts as authoritative per instructions but flag this as a likely data/routing mismatch rather than restate a false context window or chat capability. No specific benchmark scores (e.g. GenEval, DPG-Bench) were found stated by Black Forest Labs on the pages opened, so evaluations is empty. Checked BFL's current status pages directly: bfl.ai/models (the marketing showcase) no longer lists FLUX.1 [dev] and now leads with FLUX.2/FLUX 3, but docs.bfl.ai/docs.bfl.ml still documents a live, undeprecated API endpoint for it ('Generate an image with FLUX.1 [dev]', POST /v1/flux-dev), and BFL's release notes page lists only FLUX Pro 1.0 and the Finetuning API as deprecated (2025-10-31), with no mention of FLUX.1 [dev]. So FLUX.1 [dev] is absent from BFL's current marketing lineup but not confirmed deprecated; no explicit deprecation notice was found on the Hugging Face card either.
